chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era – Patriarch Subhuti's Promise: Ji Ning's True Master Revealed
chapter_meta_description: After being passed over by Daofather Crimsonbright, a mysterious immortal arrives to claim Ji Ning for the most legendary teacher in the Three Realms: Patriarch Subhuti.
og_title: Ji Ning's Luck Reverses! Subhuti Wants Him!
og_description: The most mysterious Daofather in the Three Realms, Patriarch Subhuti, sends his disciple to fetch Ji Ning. A legendary master for a legendary genius.
twitter_title: Ji Ning's Real Teacher is Here!
twitter_description: Forget Crimsonbright. A Pure Yang True Immortal just offered Ji Ning a place under the most powerful and secretive Daofather in existence.

lore_anchors.definition: An immortal being who has completely purified their foundational energy, a top-tier powerhouse below Daofather level.
The highest level of Ki Refining cultivator, a master of the Heavenly Dao and a ruler of the Three Realms.
The creator of the Starseizing Hand and the original master of Ji Ning's aquatic palace; a great power of the Primordial Era.
The most mysterious Daofather of the Three Realms, a master of both Buddhism and Daoism, famous for his ability to know all things through a single dream.
A legendary top-ten divine ability of the Three Realms, created by Daoist Threelives, which turns the cultivator's hands into ultimate weapons.
A Daofather who specializes in the Fiendgod Body Refining path, making them supremely powerful in physical combat.
A Pure Yang True Immortal whose Grand Dao is the Dao of the Sword, making them masters of lethal, supreme offense.
The most powerful Sword Immortal under Daofather Crimsonbright's lineage in the Grand Xia Dynasty.
